The '''Flight Bay Tractor Beam''' was a model of [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It was designed specifically to be used with the confines of a [[Hangar/Legends|flight bay]], capable of landing [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in cramped quarters when hooked into an installation's [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="HS" />
